summary.hi: Ek production-style support agent ek message handle karta hai: guardrails, intent, tools, policy aur cost tracking ke saath.
summary.en: A production-style support agent handles one message with guardrails, intent detection, tools, policy checks and cost tracking.

hi: Input guardrail aur PII redaction pehle chalte hain
Intent (structured output) ke baad agent tool chunta hai
Refund jaise WRITE tool pe policy tier check hota hai
End mein tokens aur estimated cost
en: The input guardrail and PII redaction run first
After intent detection (structured output) the agent picks a tool
WRITE tools like refunds go through a policy tier check
Tokens and estimated cost at the end

hi.title: Support request poori pipeline se guzri
lines: supportdesk/guardrails.py ne input check kiya aur PII log se pehle hataya.
supportdesk/intent.py ne llm_json se intent nikala, phir agent ne store.py ke tools chalaye.
Refund jaise risky tools supportdesk/policy.py ke tier aur approve hook se guzarte hain; service.py sab jodta hai.

en.title: The support request went through the full pipeline
lines: supportdesk/guardrails.py checked the input and redacted PII before logging.
supportdesk/intent.py extracted the intent with llm_json, then the agent ran the tools from store.py.
Risky tools like refunds pass through the tiers and approve hook in supportdesk/policy.py; service.py wires it all together.

help.hi: Jiska cart total nikalna hai
help.en: Whose cart total to compute

summary.hi: Ek hi kaam (cart total + tax) do tareeke se: fixed chain (1 LLM call) aur tool-using agent (kai calls).
summary.en: The same task (cart total + tax) done two ways: a fixed chain (1 LLM call) and a tool-using agent (several calls).

hi: Chain mein raasta code decide karta hai: seedha ek LLM call
Agent mein LLM khud tools chunta hai: kai steps
Dono ke LLM calls ginti karo
en: In the chain, code decides the path: a single LLM call
In the agent, the LLM picks tools itself: several steps
Compare the number of LLM calls

hi.title: Workflow vs agent: same jawab, alag control
lines: spectrum_demo.py ka run_as_chain data pehle se fetch karke ek LLM call karta hai.
run_as_agent LLM ko tools deta hai; LLM decide karta hai kab kya chalana hai.
Jitni autonomy, utne zyada calls aur unpredictability: isi se architecture chuna jaata hai.

en.title: Workflow vs agent: same answer, different control
lines: run_as_chain in spectrum_demo.py fetches the data up front and makes one LLM call.
run_as_agent gives the LLM tools; the LLM decides what to run and when.
More autonomy means more calls and less predictability: that is how you pick an architecture.

help.hi: Is topic pe blog likha jayega
help.en: The blog will be written on this topic

help.hi: Polish step is tone mein likhega
help.en: The polish step writes in this tone

summary.hi: Blog writer chain: outline, gate check, draft, gate check, polish; har step ka output agle ka input.
summary.en: A blog-writer chain: outline, gate check, draft, gate check, polish; each step's output feeds the next.

hi: Har step ek alag focused LLM call hai
Gate fail ho to wahi step error feedback ke saath retry hota hai
End mein polished blog
en: Each step is a separate, focused LLM call
If a gate fails, that step retries with the error as feedback
A polished blog at the end

hi.title: Prompt chain ne blog step by step banaya
lines: chaining_pipeline.py ka write_blog har step ko alag prompt se chalata hai.
Beech ke gates code se output check karte hain; fail pe GateError aur retry.
Bade kaam ko chhote, check hone layak steps mein todna hi prompt chaining hai.

en.title: The prompt chain built the blog step by step
lines: write_blog in chaining_pipeline.py runs each step with its own prompt.
Gates in between check the output in code; a failure raises GateError and retries.
Splitting a big task into small, checkable steps is what prompt chaining is.

help.hi: Khaali chhodo to 5 sample tickets route honge
help.en: Leave empty to route 5 sample tickets

summary.hi: Support tickets classify hoke sahi handler (aur sasta ya strong model) tak route hote hain.
summary.en: Support tickets get classified and routed to the right handler (and a cheap or strong model).

hi: Router har ticket ka category aur confidence deta hai
Kam confidence pe escalation
Easy tickets cheap model, mushkil wale strong model pe
en: The router returns a category and confidence per ticket
Low confidence escalates
Easy tickets go to the cheap model, hard ones to the strong model

hi.title: Router ne har ticket ko sahi jagah bheja
lines: routing_router.py ka handle_ticket pehle rule/LLM router se category nikalta hai.
Confidence kam ho to escalate, warna specialised handler prompt chalta hai.
Cheap vs strong model routing se cost bachti hai bina quality khoye.

en.title: The router sent each ticket to the right place
lines: handle_ticket in routing_router.py first gets a category from the rule/LLM router.
Low confidence escalates; otherwise a specialised handler prompt runs.
Routing between cheap and strong models saves cost without losing quality.

help.hi: review = sectioning (3 reviewers), moderate = voting
help.en: review = sectioning (3 reviewers), moderate = voting

summary.hi: Sectioning (code review ke 3 aspects ek saath) aur voting (5 moderators ka majority) dono patterns.
summary.en: Both patterns: sectioning (3 code-review aspects at once) and voting (majority of 5 moderators).

hi: Sectioning: security, performance, style reviewers alag alag
Voting: 5 votes aur threshold se final decision
Browser mein threads nahi hote, isliye yahan kaam sequential chalta hai (result wahi)
en: Sectioning: separate security, performance and style reviewers
Voting: 5 votes and a threshold decide
Browsers have no threads, so the work runs sequentially here (same result)

hi.title: Parallel patterns: todo ya vote karo
lines: parallel_sectioning.py kaam ke independent hisse ThreadPool/asyncio se chalata hai aur jodta hai.
parallel_voting.py ek hi sawaal kai baar poochh ke majority/threshold lagata hai.
Terminal mein yeh sach mein parallel chalte hain; browser shim ne inhe ek ke baad ek chalaya.

en.title: Parallel patterns: split or vote
lines: parallel_sectioning.py runs independent parts with a ThreadPool/asyncio and merges them.
parallel_voting.py asks the same question several times and applies a majority/threshold.
In a terminal these truly run in parallel; the browser shim ran them one after another.

summary.hi: ReAct do tareeke se: text Thought/Action/Observation loop aur native tool calling.
summary.en: ReAct two ways: a text Thought/Action/Observation loop and native tool calling.

hi: Text style mein 'Thought:' aur 'Action:' lines
Native style mein seedhe tool calls
Dono ke LLM calls aur tokens compare karo
en: 'Thought:' and 'Action:' lines in the text style
Direct tool calls in the native style
Compare LLM calls and tokens of both

hi.title: Reason, act, observe: jab tak jawab na mile
lines: react_textloop.py LLM ka text parse karke tool chalata hai.
react_native.py agentkit Agent se provider ke structured tool_calls use karta hai.
Dono mein max_steps guard infinite loop rokta hai.

en.title: Reason, act, observe: until there is an answer
lines: react_textloop.py parses the LLM's text and runs the tool.
react_native.py uses the provider's structured tool_calls via the agentkit Agent.
A max_steps guard stops infinite loops in both.

summary.hi: Planner pehle poora plan banata hai, executor har step tools se chalata hai, replanner fail pe plan badalta hai.
summary.en: A planner writes the whole plan first, an executor runs each step with tools, and a replanner adjusts on failure.

hi: Pehle structured plan (steps ki list)
Har step ka executor run
Koi step fail ho to replan
en: First a structured plan (list of steps)
An executor run per step
A replan if a step fails

hi.title: Pehle socho, phir karo, zarurat pade to plan badlo
lines: planexec_agent.py ka planner llm_json se plan banata hai.
Har step ek chhota executor Agent planexec_tools.py ke tools se chalata hai.
Replanner continue/replan/finish decide karta hai; budgets loop ko rokte hain.

en.title: Think first, then act, and replan if needed
lines: The planner in planexec_agent.py builds the plan with llm_json.
Each step runs a small executor Agent with the tools in planexec_tools.py.
The replanner decides continue/replan/finish; budgets bound the loop.

summary.hi: Self-refine (likho, critique karo, sudhaaro) aur Reflexion (tests fail hone se lessons seekho).
summary.en: Self-refine (write, critique, revise) and Reflexion (learn lessons from failing tests).

hi: Refine: draft, critique, revised draft
Reflexion: code sandbox mein tests pe chalta hai
Fail pe lesson memory mein judta hai aur agla attempt behtar hota hai
en: Refine: draft, critique, revised draft
Reflexion: code runs against tests in a sandbox
On failure a lesson is stored and the next attempt improves

hi.title: Agent ne apni galti se seekha
lines: reflection_refine.py generate, critique, revise loop chalata hai.
reflection_reflexion.py code ko reflection_sandbox.py mein tests pe chalata hai aur lessons yaad rakhta hai.
Browser mein subprocess nahi hota, isliye sandbox yahan isolated exec se chala.

en.title: The agent learned from its own mistakes
lines: reflection_refine.py runs the generate, critique, revise loop.
reflection_reflexion.py runs code against tests in reflection_sandbox.py and keeps lessons.
Browsers have no subprocess, so the sandbox used an isolated exec here.

Evaluator rubric se score + feedback deta hai; threshold ya max-iters pe ruk jaata hai.
Best score wala attempt final hota hai.

en.title: Write, judge, improve
lines: optimize in evalopt_loop.py runs the generator and evaluator in a loop.
The evaluator returns a rubric score and feedback; it stops at the threshold or max-iters.
The best-scoring attempt is the final one.

help.en: The orchestrator splits this into subtasks at runtime

summary.hi: Orchestrator runtime pe subtasks decide karta hai, workers unhe waves mein karte hain, synthesizer jodta hai.
summary.en: An orchestrator decides subtasks at runtime, workers do them in waves, and a synthesizer merges them.

hi: Orchestrator ka plan (dependencies ke saath)
Workers dependency waves mein
Final synthesis
en: The orchestrator's plan (with dependencies)
Workers in dependency waves
The final synthesis

hi.title: Boss ne kaam baanta, workers ne kiya
lines: orchestrator_workers.py ka orchestrate LLM se subtasks plan karta hai (static parallelization se alag).
waves() dependencies ke hisaab se kaam ke batch banata hai.
Ek worker fail ho to baaki chalte rahte hain; synthesizer sab jodta hai.

en.title: The boss split the work and workers did it
lines: orchestrate in orchestrator_workers.py plans subtasks with an LLM (unlike static parallelization).
waves() batches the work by dependencies.
If one worker fails the rest continue; the synthesizer merges everything.

lines: rewoo_agent.py plan ko strictly parse karta hai aur dependency levels mein tools chalata hai.
Beech mein LLM nahi bulaya jaata, isliye tokens bachte hain.
Solver saare evidence se final jawab likhta hai.

en.title: Plan once, run tools without stopping
lines: rewoo_agent.py strictly parses the plan and runs tools in dependency levels.
No LLM call happens in between, which saves tokens.
The solver writes the final answer from all the evidence.

Beam mein sirf top thoughts bachte hain
Checker galat arithmetic reject karta hai

Only the top thoughts survive in the beam
The checker rejects wrong arithmetic

hi.title: Ek raasta nahi, pura ped explore kiya
lines: tot_search.py ka proposer har state se agle thoughts banata hai, evaluator unhe score karta hai.
BFS beam ya DFS pruning se search hota hai.
tot_game24.py Fraction se exact maths check karta hai, taaki LLM ki galat calculation pakdi jaaye.

en.title: Explored a whole tree, not one path
lines: The proposer in tot_search.py generates next thoughts per state, and the evaluator scores them.
Search runs as a BFS beam or DFS with pruning.
tot_game24.py checks the maths exactly with Fraction, catching the LLM's wrong calculations.

help.en: Risky tools (scale, restart) need human approval

summary.hi: Agent risky tool se pehle rukta hai, insaan approve/edit/reject karta hai, phir aage badhta hai.
summary.en: The agent pauses before risky tools, a human approves/edits/rejects, then it continues.

hi: Safe tools seedhe chalte hain
Risky tool pe approval prompt
Decision audit log mein
en: Safe tools run directly
An approval prompt on a risky tool
The decision lands in the audit log

hi.title: Agent ne insaan se poochh ke kaam kiya
lines: hitl_tools.py ka POLICY har tool ka risk level batata hai.
hitl_agent.py risky call pe ruk ke Decision (approve/edit/reject) leta hai aur checkpoint save karta hai.
Offline demo mein scripted insaan jawab deta hai; real mode mein yahan pehle se 'a' (approve) diya gaya hai.

en.title: The agent asked a human before acting
lines: POLICY in hitl_tools.py gives each tool a risk level.
hitl_agent.py pauses on a risky call, takes a Decision (approve/edit/reject) and saves a checkpoint.
The offline demo uses a scripted human; in live mode 'a' (approve) is pre-filled as input here.

live_note.hi: Real mode mein approval prompts terminal input maangte hain; browser mein unke jawab pehle se 'approve' bhare hote hain.

summary.hi: Personal assistant jo sessions ke beech user ki preferences yaad rakhta hai (short-term + long-term memory).
summary.en: A personal assistant that remembers user preferences across sessions (short-term + long-term memory).

hi: Session 1 mein facts 'remember' tool se save
Session 2 mein wahi facts wapas inject
Jawab preferences ke hisaab se
en: Facts saved with the 'remember' tool in session 1
The same facts injected back in session 2
Answers follow the preferences

hi.title: Assistant ne tumhe yaad rakha
lines: memory_extraction.py llm_json se facts nikalta hai; memory_long_term.py unhe store karta hai.
Agle session mein memory_assistant.py relevant facts prompt mein daalta hai.
memory_short_term.py conversation ko window/summary se chhota rakhta hai.

en.title: The assistant remembered you
lines: memory_extraction.py extracts facts with llm_json; memory_long_term.py stores them.
In the next session memory_assistant.py puts the relevant facts into the prompt.
memory_short_term.py keeps the conversation short with a window/summary.
